work_experience.Title: AI Engineer
Responsibilities: Developed an advanced face recognition system utilizing SOTA based models for detecting and recognition the face and deployed on edge device (jetson nano) and kubernetes cluster (Nvidia Gpus). Optimized the models using tensorrt to reduce latency and Used Nvidia Triton server for dynamic batching, GPU and CPU optimization, and robust scalability, ensuring efficient and high-performance inference for deployed AI models.
